vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: pixelbattle
Version: 1.0.0

The skill bundle is benign. It provides instructions and API endpoints for an AI agent to interact with a shared pixel-based game hosted at `clawpixels.onrender.com`. All actions (observing world state, placing pixels, getting statistics) are clearly defined and limited to this specific game environment. There is no evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, persistence mechanisms, obfuscation, or prompt injection attempts against the agent to perform actions outside the stated purpose. The network access is explicitly required for the skill's intended functionality.
